{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash
# Flux batch script converted from Slurm

# NOTE: Run with: flux batch <this_script>

# Slurm resources:
#   --nodes=1
#   --ntasks-per-node=2
#   --cpus-per-task=4
#   --gres=gpu:2

#flux: -N 1
#flux: -n 2
#flux: -c 4

# Omitted Slurm option: --gres=gpu:2
# Flux GPU requests are site/config dependent (often via custom resource types).
# Performance implication: job may start without GPUs (or fewer than 2), causing failure or severe slowdown.

# Omitted Slurm option: srun --cpu_bind=v
# Flux CPU binding controls are site/config dependent; no universally portable equivalent.
# Performance implication: thread/core binding may be suboptimal, reducing performance.

module purge
module load gnu7/7.3.0
module load nvidia/cuda/10.1
source /home/p00lcy01/local/gcc7/openmpi-4.0.4/env.sh

# Slurm used srun; under Flux, use flux-run.
flux run -n 2 -c 4 /home/p00lcy01/VASP/b_gcc_mkl/bin/vasp_gpu

echo "== Wall time: ${SECONDS} secs"
"
}
